summary: How to update an AAPS app built with Android Studio: export settings, check the Android Studio and JVM versions, fetch and pull the new code with git, build the signed APK with the same keystore, and install it. Menu names (Git > Fetch, Pull) are Android Studio labels, not AAPS app strings.
